label: Finding-103
title: scale-70pc-websites: 1 smaller precision and sourcing point
description: Outlets disagree on the W3Techs figure: about 69-70% versus about 75%: Tenable (69.3%), Imperva (over 69%) and Insurance Business (around 70%, 'W3Techs (August 2026)') against Reuters via RTE and ABC Australia ('roughly 75%' / 'about 75 per cent' of websites whose programming language can be identified). RTE and ABC are vault captures outside the site manifest. The difference may be a date or a different W3Techs measure; capturing W3Techs would settle it.
